verdict.rationale: Shopify POS documents that inventory at every location syncs in real time across POS, the online store and every sales channel. Staff can update stock with Quick counts, and exchanges update inventory instantly. However, the evidence shows no explicit item-catalog management (creating or editing products and variants), and a community report of an inventory-count overflow bug is a single isolated defect, not a contradiction of the sync capability. missing for 10: documented catalog/product creation and editing workflow, explicit multi-register sync detail, independent hands-on corroboration of real-time sync reliability

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can manage an item catalog with inventory counts that stay in sync across registers and channels

citations.quote: Track and assign inventory at every location that syncs in real time across POS, online store, and every sales channel.
Shopify POS syncs with Shopify to track your orders and inventory across your retail locations, online store, and other active sales channels.
Use Quick counts with a barcode scanner to update stock quantities on the spot in Shopify POS.
Accept exchanges for purchases made online or at another location and your inventory will be updated instantly.
